role_evidence.quote: To evaluate the efficacy of local targeted therapy with the alpha-emitter-labeled neuropeptide \[225Ac\]Ac-DOTA-SP, administered using the forced diffusion method, in patients with newly diagnosed WHO grade G3-G4 glioma after first-line treatment.

coder_notes: Phase NA single-arm study. Population is diffuse glioma CNS WHO G3-G4 with glioblastoma named in conditions; no IDH requirement, 'WHO III-IV' grading in conditions -> historical. Candidate moiety named by ligand without isotope per W1 (dota-sp; substance P derivative). Delivered locally via catheter/Rickham reservoir with forced diffusion: coded formulation new_route; device_dependent false since catheter delivery is a route rather than device activation/FUS-type delivery (adjudicator may differ). Mannitol and dexamethasone are listed as pre-treatment medication without stated purpose; coded supportive (no BBB-opening purpose stated). 0.9% NaCl not listed as a drug. Concurrent chemotherapy at oncologist's discretion is not a protocol agent; regimen coded monotherapy. tumour_pk_planned yes based on quantitative SPECT/CT distribution imaging of the administered radiopharmaceutical; adjudicator may consider this imaging biodistribution rather than tumour PK.
